results: 1. MRI of the brain with and without contrast, focusing on the posterior fossa
MRI brain with gadolinium: normal brainstem; subtle medial orbital wall fracture with medial rectus involvement
MRI diffusion-weighted sequences: normal
MRI susceptibility-weighted sequences: epidural haemorrhage
2. CT angiography of the head and neck
CT / MR angiography (posterior circulation): normal
CT / MR angiography (circle of Willis): normal / non-contributory
3. Neurological examination including assessment of extraocular movements in all directions
cranial nerve examination: limited right eye adduction failing to cross midline, with left abducting nystagmus on left gaze; otherwise normal
video-oculography / eye-movement recording: reduced right adduction with left abducting nystagmus; resolved over two weeks
nystagmus: direction and whether it changes with gaze: no nystagmus
smooth pursuit and saccades: normal
adduction in horizontal gaze (each eye): limited adduction of the RIGHT eye that fails to cross the midline, with abducting nystagmus of the left eye on left gaze - mimics an INO
abducting nystagmus of the fellow eye: absent
vertical gaze and convergence: normal
skew deviation / alternating cover test: no vertical misalignment
ocular torsion and head tilt: none
subjective visual vertical: within normal limits
head impulse test: normal - no corrective saccade
pupil size and light reaction: equal and reactive
ptosis / lid position: none
